coverage.enumeration_method: Current H2 native instance ledger. Non-R/C/L/FB reference-prefix screen intentionally includes some RF passives/crystals/fuses/testpoints whose designators are U/Y/F/TP; this 287-row screen is not claimed to be 287 semiconductors.
coverage.usb_connector_unification_owner: Root exact four-USB task; not duplicated here
coverage.comparison_limit: Fourteen bounded family groups; full 1208 inventory verified for counts, not a claim that all 245 groups are replacement-qualified.

groups.assessment: Strongest additional candidate. U69 RX-source switch is an explicitly retained legacy/reference MPN; U68/U72/U85 use a second single-SPDT family. All four current endpoints use 3V3_MAIN and AUDIO_GROUND. Source maps have the same numbered COM/VCC/GND/select and alternate-port positions; the exact packages differ (DBV SOT-23-6 versus DCK SC70-6).
requirements: Preserve low/high selection and all six physical contact meanings; this is not approval based only on symbol pin count.
TS5A63157 has explicit powered-off isolation and overshoot/undershoot protection; do not replace its three existing uses with an unqualified weaker switch.
Primary TI pages list SN74LVC1G3157 -40..125 C and TS5A63157 -40..85 C; product local maximum temperature for the proposed U69 replacement is not established by this audit.
At actual 3.3-V bias/load, compare on-resistance, leakage, charge injection, pop/click, power-off injection and footprint/routing. No audio qualification follows.
groups.next_step: Review using the existing TS5A63157 family for U69 first, preserving the three protected uses. Exact package/JLC route and circuit acceptance must precede replacement.

current_u69.default_when_supply_valid_and_driver_hig: Pin 3 / Si4732 path; selection L -> B1/NC, H -> B2/NO for both families
current_u69.input_bias: R165 and R210, each 100 kohm to AUDIO_VMID_MAIN; complete signal excursion/fault envelope not measured or proved by connectivity

common.physical_function_mapping: 1 alternate high, 2 GND, 3 alternate low, 4 COM, 5 VCC, 6 control

lvc.ron_conditions: VCC=3 V, signal 0..VCC, IA=-24 mA, DBV/DCK, full stated temperature range, by-design specification
lvc.off_leakage_condition: VCC=1.65..5.5 V, signal within rails; not a powered-off protection claim
lvc.powered_off_isolation: Not established by the cited switch-OFF leakage row

ts5a.ron_conditions: V+=3 V, signal 0..V+, ICOM=-24 mA, full stated temperature range
ts5a.powered_off_condition: V+=0 V, signals 0..3.6 V, full temperature
ts5a.additional_behavior: Explicit power-off isolation and overshoot/undershoot handling; these do not qualify the current complete audio chain

remaining_checks: U106 guaranteed output levels with actual rail/load and partial-power states
Local maximum ambient <=85 C for the selected TS5A exact package
Package/land replacement, six net/pin identities and placement/routing
Pop/click, charge injection and noise with current impedances
Exact live JLC Standard availability and cost before accepting a replacement
bounded_circuit_comparison.verdict: Real bounded unification candidate for U69, not a drop-in or an approved replacement. No demonstrated need for the legacy split was found in the scoped history, but that is not proof of application equivalence.

groups.assessment: NFC U97 is a separate single comparator while RF evidence uses three TLV1821 singles and two TLV1824 quads. NFC and RF singles both run from AON_SAFE_3V3. This makes family consolidation worth comparing, but it is not an unexplained electrical duplicate: NFC was a separately reviewed low-cost field-envelope circuit, and the TLV family has explicit startup high-Z/POR and rail-to-rail input characteristics.
requirements: Actual pinout differs: LMV331 IN+=1,GND=2,IN-=3,OUT=4,VCC=5; TLV1821 OUT=1,V-=2,IN+=3,IN-=4,V+=5. No drop-in substitution.
Recalculate NFC threshold/hysteresis, input bias/offset, common-mode range, loading and no-false-negative timing; retain AON-safe output semantics.
The 2.7..5.5-V LMV331 and 2.4..40-V TLV1821 supply ranges alone do not prove interchangeability. Same nominal 3.3-V rail is not sufficient.
Single versus quad comparators serve physically separate detector groups; removing package variants may worsen detector locality.
groups.next_step: Keep current comparator selection until a small electrical/economic comparison establishes a real benefit. Existing NFC behavior is not qualified by this audit.

groups.assessment: Two 8-bit control expanders, one 16-bit AON evidence device, one 16-bit UI device with hardware reset, and one 24-bit slow-I/O device are not the same interface. Bus/address/reset/domain obligations differ.
requirements: Current TCA9535 evidence_mask pin3 is grounded A2, but TCA9539 ui_matrix_io pin3 is RESET_N=S3_RESET_N: swapping those nominally similar TSSOP24 parts would assert/reset or alter addressing.
TCA9535 uses safety-private I2C/AON, while TCA9539 uses SYS_UI_I2C/3V3_MAIN and address0x74.
TCA9534A address family0x38..0x3F and TCA6424A0x22/0x23 plus 24-port allocation must remain. Larger uniform expanders require PCB, firmware and safety changes.
groups.next_step: No family-wide replacement. Only compare exact per-instance spare-port/area economics if a later revision needs it.

groups.assessment: AON uses a 300-mA low-Iq buck, MAIN a 6-A converter, and external5V/voice4V already share two instances of one 4-A converter. Different current/Iq, feedback/control/power-good and inductors are material requirements, not random suppliers.
requirements: All are fed from NVDC_SYS, but AON is autonomous, MAIN EN follows POR_N and external/voice rails have independent safe enables.
Do not downsize MAIN/AON function or bypass reopened native startup/current/voltage-drop findings for BOM uniformity.

groups.assessment: AON low-current protection, MAIN/voice PG circuit breakers, external-port true-reverse-blocking latch-off eFuses and adjustable backlight protection have different functions. MAIN/voice already share TPS25974; the two external ports share TPS259470.
requirements: TPS259470 AUXOFF/FLT and TPS25974 PG/PGTH occupy different functions despite similar10-pin packages; preserve reverse-source protection on externally powered accessories.
AON startup/current drop is still an open engineering finding, not evidence that TPS25961 is qualified or a reason to erase the requirement.
Backlight current limit/latch-off/reverse blocking is not replaced by an ordinary load switch.

groups.assessment: Eight distinct local switched rails already use TPS22919DCKR. No parallel LDO-like family appears in this fitted set.
requirements: Retain each local rail, QOD and enable behavior; merging physical power domains is not component unification.

groups.assessment: Two TPS3839 instances supervise receiver/codec switched supplies with active-low push-pull output and typical200-ms release. Four TPS3808 instances supply separate SENSE/MR/programmable-delay/open-drain functions for voice/external/AON safety.
requirements: Output type, external sense node, manual-reset input and release delay differ; nominal3.07/3.08-V thresholds do not make them equivalent.
Do not convert typical timing to guaranteed bounds. Retain current TPS3808 timing/POR review limitations.

groups.assessment: Four dual-SPDT TMUX1136s, two bilateral-SPST SN74LVC2G66s, one auto-direction translator, one hot-swap/stuck-bus I2C buffer, one safety I2C boundary and three USB DPDT isolation switches are not interchangeable analog muxes.
requirements: Preserve channel topology, rail-off high-Z, voltage translation, direction control, rise-time/stuck-bus recovery and USB data properties.
USB switch IC unification is already complete at three FSUSB42MUX instances; this does not settle current functional USB service-policy qualification.

groups.assessment: Three2-channel service-USB arrays, fourteen4-channel fast-signal arrays, two8-channel keypad arrays, one Type-C OVP protector, one VBUS TVS and RF diodes serve different capacitance/channel/clamp/voltage roles. A theoretical move from2-channel to4-channel ESD would eliminate one MPN but add unused channels and a different footprint/clamp; that is not currently justified.
requirements: TPD8E003 typical9pF is not a substitute for the low-capacitance USB/RF classes.
TPD4S201 short-to-VBUS protection is not equivalent to an ESD-only diode array.
Voice RF uses24-V bidirectional Nexperia devices; low-power antenna ESD is a separate design class. Preserve RF power/signal swing and clamping review.

groups.assessment: TI/Nexperia names mainly represent different gates or channel densities. Single/dual/quad active-high125/126-like buffers are not just supplier duplicates. 1G06 inverts;1G07 does not; open-drain, tristate and bilateral bus switches have different contracts.
requirements: Retain Ioff, OE polarity, Schmitt behavior, output type and per-domain supply/reset behavior. HC20 input levels must not be silently treated as LVC.
Quad consolidation of remote singles would require local repacking and connecting separated domains; compare only true colocated same-supply same-polarity instances.

groups.assessment: Five low-gate-drive20-V single NMOS, five dual60-V NMOS, two NPN qualifiers and one common-drain battery-FET pair are different topologies/loads. BAT54 single/common-anode/series and BAV70 common-cathode devices likewise differ electrically despite family-name resemblance.
requirements: Preserve low-VGS load current, reset sink behavior, leakage, diode direction and package pinout. Single/dual dice or common-anode/cathode substitutions are not label cleanup.

groups.assessment: Sixteen ordinary top-actuated B3S buttons and eight side-actuated SKRT service buttons are already unified within mechanical role. The latching slide switch and rotary encoder are separate functions. Nine red TX indicators and one orange fault indicator use one LED family with intentional color difference.
requirements: Do not exchange top and side actuation or momentary and maintained behavior. Keep service recess, B3S actuator datum, encoder mechanics and fault/TX color distinction.

groups.assessment: Six service headers share one MPN; five U.FLs share one MPN; eight SMA plus two RP-SMA intentionally differ by mating polarity; M1 plug/receptacle are complementary halves. Cap, display, SD, Grove and headset require different mating interfaces.
requirements: No consolidation across different contact count/pitch/polarity/keying or external plug standards. Existing fit/solder/access gates stay open.

groups.assessment: The two ordinary op-amps already share TLV9061; two safety MCUs share MSPM0; two RP MCUs share SC1512-A4; three nRF radios share E01. S3/C5, VHF/UHF radios, carrier/demodulating IR receivers and 2.7-GHz versus7-GHz RF detector families implement different features/frequency coverage.
requirements: Retain Wi-Fi bands/memory/USB/CPU roles, RF band-specific matching/calibration and IR raw-carrier versus demodulated output. No MCU/RF feature removal for BOM uniformity.

summary.strongest_additional_candidate: Single-SPDT U69 legacy SN74LVC1G3157 versus existing TS5A63157 family; review only, no adoption.
summary.secondary_candidate: NFC LMV331 versus existing TLV1821 family: no drop-in and safety/threshold/economic evidence required.
summary.conclusion: Most apparent variety is already normalized by function or has explicit channel/polarity/power/mechanical differences. No other unconditional same-function replacement is established.

snapshot_scope: Immutable pre-USB-unification inventory at base_commit; later source hashes and board group counts may differ. Not current build evidence.
